modbus_standalone_advisory.title: FoxESS Modern running in Standalone Connection mode
modbus_standalone_advisory.description:
FoxESS Modern is currently connected directly to `{host}:{port}` via its built-in Modbus transport.

If you have other devices (such as energy meters, EV chargers, or secondary inverters) sharing this RS-485 serial gateway, configure a shared Modbus hub in `configuration.yaml` to enable central connection pooling and prevent serial bus collisions:

```yaml
modbus:
  - name: waveshare_gateway
    type: tcp
    host: {host}
    port: {port}
    timeout: 5
    message_wait_milliseconds: 250
```

Once added, restart Home Assistant and FoxESS Modern will automatically transition to the shared Core Modbus connection.
